# 3D Asset Auto

> Local-first 3D asset runtime: reference image → TRELLIS.2 → Blender → agent inspection → GLB. Generation provider is independent of editing: the agent chooses no rig, rigid object motion, a SkinTokens draft, custom Blender scripts or compatible clip merging. Kimodo motion and Tripo are used only when explicitly selected by the user. Godot checks are project-dependent and interactive viewers require a user request.

Human guides are available in [English](README.en.md) and [한국어](README.md). Paired guides link to their other language at the top; the installation guide and agent/runtime references are written in English.

## Install and operate

- [Install](INSTALL.md): Default TRELLIS/models/Blender installation, skill links, optional engine/viewer/MCP components and updates.
- [Quick start](QUICKSTART.en.md): Generation, edits, asynchronous jobs and visual review.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository commands, source contracts and maintenance invariants.
- [Asset skill](.agents/skills/3d-assets/SKILL.md): Workflow for creating and reviewing assets.
- [Request fields](.agents/skills/3d-assets/references/specs.md): Generation and edit specifications.
- [Runtime reference](.agents/skills/3d-assets/references/runtime.md): CLI commands and artifact layout.
- [Tripo option](docs/TRIPO.en.md): Explicit provider choice, private key setup, PNG/JPEG and multiview inputs, automatic standard generation with optional credit limit, and known-task recovery.
- [Character and part processing](docs/CHARACTERS.en.md): Default local rigging, motion, agent-prompted semantic parts, character imports and provider-aware recovery.
- [Blender editing and clips](docs/BLENDER.en.md): Trusted local scripts for object/custom motion, rig/weight/material changes, compatible clip merging, animation preservation and checkpoint recovery.
- [Kimodo text motion](docs/KIMODO.en.md): Explicitly selected humanoid work prioritizes reference review, rig checks, Kimodo drafts, Blender finishing and final comparison; observed mapping, clip preservation, pinned setup and recovery.
- [Usage and quality](docs/QUALITY.en.md): Purpose-based functional criteria, representation limits, playback contracts, optional final-GLB motion assessment, critical frames and scoped evidence.
- [Image and video motion references](docs/MOTION_REFERENCES.en.md): Initial design for complex/creative clips, optional Grok Imagine headless use, actual media completion, timestamped frame review and selective Blender application; not automatic motion capture.
- [Surface diagnosis and finishing](docs/FINISHING.en.md): Locate the first damaged processing stage, distinguish seams/holes/fragments, and reuse a repair workflow only under matching conditions.
- [Clip preservation comparison](docs/BLENDER.en.md#editing-one-clip-and-comparing-preservation): Read-only `compare-animations` / `compare_asset_animations`, declared clip edits, exact time/channel/model differences and limits of preservation evidence.

## Game VFX

- [game-vfx skill](.agents/skills/game-vfx/SKILL.md): Separate Blender-first effect authoring and per-effect review. Procedural fields, paths, particles and shaders are valid; use 3d-assets only for needed physical mesh components. Resolve the installed skill path to find its shared runtime.
- [game-vfx design and execution](docs/GAME_VFX_DESIGN.en.md): Initial Blender noise/lightning helper and reusable fire, baked ice and lightning Three.js gallery. Setup, media preparation, preview commands, scoped MIT web/GPL Blender-helper licenses and current limits. No general generation CLI/MCP or automatic cross-engine converter.
- [VFX runtime contract](.agents/skills/game-vfx/references/runtime.md): Actual helper flags/outputs, full-gallery media list, per-effect resources, absolute-time playback, layers, ownership and focused checks. Individual effects do not require the full gallery or model inference.
- [VFX authoring and experiments](docs/VFX.en.md): Current implementation alongside retained shockwave, 2D flipbook and fragment physics-to-GLB studies. Shader/particle runtime is separate from GLB; code availability and numeric checks do not prove visual quality or target performance.

## Understand and troubleshoot

- [Overview](README.en.md): Implemented scope, verified results and current limitations.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.en.md): Components, coordinate conventions, revisions and separate quality gates.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.en.md): Offline viewer, downloads, environment locks and interrupted jobs.

This file is a navigation aid, not an installer or a guarantee that every client automatically reads it. Install the shared checkout before linking its skill; add learned postprocessing models only when needed. Kimodo provides a separate learned humanoid-motion path with mapped retargeting; local presets and custom authoring remain available without that model. Import rigs as `character`, or unrigged object/morph clips as `animated`; static import/edit reject animation. General automatic retarget solvers, retopology, texture rebaking and TRELLIS multiview are not implemented. Inspect actual geometry, complementary views of moving states and part previews; ready files, inferred outputs and visually approved results are separate states.
